resources.string: Boost notifications from your most important apps into a banner that pops up on top of whatever app you\'re using — so you never miss them.
AlwaysNotify needs permission to read incoming notifications so it can boost the ones you care about.

Required: lets AlwaysNotify pop the boosted alert on top of whatever app you\'re using. AlwaysNotify never posts its own notification — this overlay banner is the only alert it shows, so it only appears while your device is unlocked and in use.
Display over other apps is granted.
Display over other apps is NOT granted.
Pick which apps should get the boosted overlay banner.
